name: Google Analytics
description: A free analytics tool from Google that helps businesses understand customer behavior across websites and apps, with cross-platform measurement and machine-learning-based insights to improve marketing ROI.
best_for: Positioned for businesses of every size, from small businesses wanting free/easy measurement to enterprises wanting analytics unified with Google's advertising platforms (Google Ads, Display & Video 360).

tiers.name: Google Analytics (Standard)
tiers.notes: Free with unlimited use; no seat or usage-based pricing published.

tiers.name: Google Analytics 360 (Enterprise)
tiers.notes: Custom, contact-sales pricing not publicly listed. Adds longer data-retention options (26/38/50 months vs. the standard tier's 2-14 months), a materially higher API sampling ceiling, SLAs, and BigQuery export improvements.

cons: User-level and event-level data used by Explorations and funnel reports is retained for at most 2 or 14 months on a standard property (26-50 months only on paid 360), and demographic data always expires after 2 months regardless of setting.

Rows involving demographics, interest categories, or low-count search queries are silently withheld from reports to prevent identifying individual users, and these system-defined thresholds cannot be adjusted, viewed, or disabled by admins on any tier.

Once a query on the free tier exceeds Google's per-query event limit, results become statistically sampled rather than exact; Analytics 360 (paid) gets a much higher sampling ceiling and an unsampled option that free-tier users don't have.
features: Native integrations with Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Search Console, Google Cloud

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.

alternatives.name: WhatConverts
alternatives.description: A lead tracking and reporting platform that attributes calls, form submissions, chats, and e-commerce transactions back to the specific marketing campaign, keyword, or channel that generated them.
alternatives.best_for: Marketing agencies and businesses that need call/form/chat lead-source attribution rather than general website analytics.
